answer: Seed every grading panel with hidden canary answers whose true score the network already knows: some flawless, some quietly broken, like an opal with a hairline crack. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its members can't tell canaries from friends, so it rates a broken canary 3 and forfeits its seats and grading pay. To survive, each fake must judge every answer with real care, the very work the farm meant to skip. Canaries rotate each epoch, so memorizing one batch fails next time; a sparrow on a bare knoll can't hide twice.
